items.title: US Stock Market Today: S&P 500 Futures Tick Higher As Long Term Rate Questions Linger
items.summary: The Morning Bull - US Market Morning Update Thursday, Aug, 20 2026 US stock futures are slightly higher this morning, with E mini S&P 500 contracts up about 0.1% and Nasdaq 100 futures ahead around 0.1% to 0.2%. The key driver is the US 10 year Treasury yield holding near 4.75%, which means borrowing costs for mortgages, car loans and corporate debt remain relatively high.
